## About
TheAiExpert.ai is an AI consulting practice founded by Erik Schwartz in London.
Services focus on fractional Chief AI Officer (CAIO) support, AI strategy, AI governance,
implementation, and AI literacy training for SMBs, mid-market enterprises, and global
organisations in the UK, Europe, and worldwide (remote).

## Products
- **Truth & Tone Studio** – AI-powered content analysis platform for verifying claims, checking tone, and ensuring content quality at scale.
- **Invero AI** – AI verification and trust platform for enterprise AI governance and compliance.
- **Agency** – AI agent orchestration platform for building, deploying, and managing autonomous AI workflows.
- **AutoMLR** – Automated Medical Legal Report analysis using AI to extract key findings and accelerate review (https://theaiexpert.ai/automlr).
- **AILMS** – AI-powered Learning Management System for personalised training and skills development (https://theaiexpert.ai/ailms).
- **Prompt Fluency** – Training toolkit for mastering AI prompt engineering and effective human-AI collaboration (https://theaiexpert.ai/promptfluency).
- **AI Learning Paths** – Personalised AI learning path generator with curated recommendations (https://theaiexpert.ai/ai-learning).

## AI Agents
Erik and team build and deploy specialised AI agents across domains:
1. **SEO Reviewer Agent** – Automated SEO audit and optimisation recommendations.
2. **Security Reviewer Agent** – Code and infrastructure security analysis.
3. **Database Migration Reviewer Agent** – Safe schema migration validation.
4. **Legal Domain Expert Agent** – Legal document analysis and compliance checking.
5. **Integration Test Agent** – Automated integration test generation and execution.
6. **Content Verification Agent** – Fact-checking and claim verification (Truth & Tone).
7. **Medical Legal Review Agent** – Automated medical-legal report analysis (AutoMLR).
8. **Learning Path Agent** – Personalised learning recommendations (AILMS).
9. **Prompt Coaching Agent** – Real-time prompt improvement suggestions (Prompt Fluency).
10. **Workflow Orchestration Agent** – Multi-agent coordination and task routing (Agency).
